name: Shadow Totem, Lesser (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Barbarian 6, darkvision 60 ft.

Benefit: While raging, each time the barbarian confirms a critical hit her weapon surges with draining shadows. The target must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 the barbarian’s level + her Constitution modifier) or take 1d4 Strength damage. This is a negative energy effect.
